title: Cross-Field Logical Consistency Rules
description: Multi-column relationship validation to prevent logical contradictions within individual entities.
conditions: Hierarchical or chronologically linked attributes (e.g., diagnosis_date and death_date)
Mutually exclusive flags or conditional requirements (e.g., pregnant=True and biological_sex='Male')
Aggregated totals that should match component sums (e.g., subtotal + tax = total)
recommended_methods: Boolean rule matrix evaluation across column pairs
Chronological sequence assertions (Event A <= Event B)
Arithmetic balance checking with tolerance epsilon (1e-4)
selection_rules: If death_date < diagnosis_date, quarantine record for temporal inconsistency
If component sum deviates from reported total by > 1%, record accounting discrepancy warning
If conditional dependency is violated (e.g. surgery_type present but had_surgery=False), reconcile flags
limitations: Requires comprehensive domain business rules before validation
Complex cross-field rules increase execution time on massive multi-million row datasets
